cases.name: v15-to-v16-is-lazy
cases.notes: §3.4 step 16: no DDL and no data pass. A 15.x store's nodes are all `[`-form and its frontmatter blobs all raw — exactly the 16.0 checkpoint forms — so every existing revision is a checkpoint and the step only moves user_version; the rows are untouched byte for byte. Deltas appear with the next commit (§4.4). Since 17.0 the opener continues to step 17, so `docs` comes out with the 17.0 columns (its one row is projected to show the backfill over this pre-state too).

cases.name: v16-to-v17-heads-inline-bytes-time
cases.notes: Step 17 (modular-core Phase 3a — M1, M2, D10, D6): `docs` rebuilt with `head` (= `current_rev`), `frontmatter_raw` (the live head's frontmatter RESOLVED through the 16.x delta chain once — r_2's blob is a `{"f":…}` delta over r_1's raw, so a.md comes out `layer: working`), `created_at` (the seq-1 revision's commit ts), `updated_at` (the head's commit ts), `deleted_at` (the tombstone commit's ts; gone.md was deleted by c_3); `blocks` rebuilt with `raw`/`trivia` copied from `blobs` by hash (b_3's NULL trivia_hash stays a NULL trivia), `created_at`/`updated_at` from MIN/MAX(commits.ts) over the block's `block_changes` (b_1: c_1; b_2: c_2) falling back to `created_commit`'s ts when it has none (b_3: c_1), `deleted_at` from `deleted_commit` (b_3: c_3); `created_commit`/`deleted_commit` gone and the two partial indexes re-created over `deleted_at`; `resurrection_pool` rebuilt with `created_at` = MIN over the block's `block_changes` (b_4: c_2), else the deleting commit's ts (b_3: c_3). The history tables (`revisions`, `blobs`, `tree_nodes`, `commits`, `block_changes`) are untouched — the recorder's, read once for the backfill. `rowid`s are kept (the FTS index is keyed by them). (3b — M3/D5) `resurrection_pool.deleted_commit` → `deleted_at` (the deleting commit's ts: b_3 c_3, b_4 c_4; `expires_ts` is already `deleted_at + 30 days`). `id_claims` created and backfilled: `d_1`/`d_2` from `docs` (`minted_at = created_at`, bit 0) plus bit 1 from their `revisions` rows → 3; `b_1`/`b_2` from `blocks` (bit 0, `minted_at = created_at`) plus bit 1 from `block_changes` → 3; `b_3` from its tombstoned `blocks` row alone → 1 (no `block_changes` row names it); `b_4` from the pool row (bit 0) plus `block_changes` (bit 1) → 3, `minted_at` the earliest of the two sources (c_2); `r_2`/`r_3` as heads (bit 0, `minted_at = docs.updated_at`) plus `revisions` (bit 1) → 3; `r_1` from `revisions` alone → 2 (an old revision's id names no core row); `rp_1` → 1 at the repo's first commit's ts. The commits `c_1`…`c_4` get no claim (the recorder's own rows). Tables the pre-state lacks (`dispositions`, `edges`, `external_nodes`, `sources`, `pending_materializations`) contribute nothing. (3c — M4) `pending_materializations` rebuilt self-contained: `head` = the row's `rev_id` (the same `r_` token — a.md's write row names r_2), `prior_hash` = the `rendered_hash` of the revision before it, resolved ONCE from the 16.x history (r_1's X'05'; NULL for the `remove` row, as for a first revision), `created_at` = the recording commit's `ts` (c_2 for the write, c_3 for the remove), `rev_id` and both foreign keys gone, `rowid`s kept. (3d — D7/M5, D4) `repos` rebuilt with the EPOCH (`ep_0`, the fixture minter's first `ep`; its claim minted at the repo's first commit's ts, bit 0). `feed` backfilled from `commits` — one row per commit under the new epoch, `seq = commits.seq`, `batch_id = commit_id` (no checkpoint grouped them), `plan_id` NULL — and `feed_entries` from `revisions` (r_1 `created` at a.md, r_2 `changed`, r_3 `created` at gone.md, each with the revision's rendered hash) plus one `deleted` entry for gone.md under c_3 (the tombstone whose `deleted_at` is its ts); c_4 (b_4's deletion with no revision and no tombstone) has no entry; c_5 — an `api` commit with no revision whose reason is `move old.md -> a.md` — gets the one `moved` entry the backfill ever writes (resolution 12): the doc now at a.md (d_1) with its current head and hash, `from_path = old.md`. The `c` claims appear: bit 0 from the feed, bit 1 from `commits` → 3, `minted_at` the commit's ts. `commits` rebuilt with `epoch`/`batch_id` and without `checkpoint_id`, `rowid`s kept. `sync_state` gains the three status columns and the reserved row `('', '')` from the latest `checkpoints` row by ts (cp_1: `last_batch_ts`, `last_batch_id` NULL — unknowable — `last_batch_files` 3, the array's length); the attachment cursor row is untouched; `checkpoints` is dropped (its `cp_` ids get no claim).
